column6: Maiden, glossy mane, lovely beauty, @wDN{Inana}, glossy mane, lovely beauty! Maiden, mane of the ibex, …… red deer, …… red deer, Inana, mane of the ibex, …… red deer, …… red deer! Maiden, colourful as a pile of grain, fit for the king, @wDN{Inana}, colourful as a pile of grain, fit for @wDN{Dumuzid}! Maiden, you are a shock of two-row barley, fully developed in loveliness, @wDN{Inana}, you are a shock of two-row barley, fully developed in loveliness!

I am the queen, I am the queen, I am …… full of loveliness! I am the maiden, I am the queen, I am …… full of loveliness! I am the queen, seed engendered by @wDN{An}, I am …… full of loveliness! I am good oil, good oil, …… sweet perfume! …… may he moor the boat ……. …… may he moor the boat …….

I am the queen, I shall go with him to his ……. I am @wDN{Inana}, I shall go with him to his ……. I shall go with him to his ……. I shall go with him to his …… shrine. I shall go with him to the house with its measuring jars.

Let me learn the way to the man, my milk, my cream! Let me learn the way to my @wDN{Ama-ušum}, my milk, my cream! Let me learn the way to @wDN{Ama-ušumgal-ana}, my milk, my cream! Let me learn the way to the esparto grass, my milk, to my milk, my milk! Let me learn the way to the poplars, the cool place, my milk! Let me learn the way to the @fsux{innuš} plants, the pure plants, my milk! Let me learn the way to the grasslands, the frosty place, my milk! Let me learn the way to the holy sheepfold, my man's sheepfold! Let me learn the way to the holy sheepfold, my @wDN{Dumuzid's} sheepfold!
